opening: This act wires the three stacks through CloudFormation exports and imports, the way a CDK app does. No component file names the new reads.

pull-request.prompt: Add a third subnet to network and export it; have app import it for a worker, and edge import that.
pull-request.reply: Opened pull request {pull}. network adds subnet c and exports its id, app imports it, edge imports app's export. Next: plan all three.

pull-request.status: Planning network, app and edge together

tips.title: Reads found in the templates
tips.body: An Fn::ImportValue of a name another stack in the project exports is a read of that stack's output. chant orders the importer after the exporter and lists the read like one a component file states.

planned.reply: One plan across 3 stacks. Two values are unknown: subnet c's id, which app imports, and the interface's id, which edge imports.

planned.prompt: How can app be planned before the export exists?
planned.reply: CloudFormation refuses a change set that imports an export that does not exist yet, so chant plans app from a copy of its template in which the import is a stand-in parameter.

tips.title: A stand-in for the import
tips.body: The preview marks the worker's SubnetId as known after apply. Before it runs the real change set, chant checks it against the preview.

approved.status: Recording your approval on the pull request

tips.title: One approval
tips.body: Once network applies, chant plans app again with the real export. The approval already given covers that plan if it only fills in what the preview marked unknown.

merged.status: Merging and applying network, app and edge in one pass

tips.title: An export in use
tips.body: CloudFormation refuses to change or remove an export another stack imports. chant refuses such a plan before anything applies, and names both stacks.

applying.status: Applying network, app and edge together

tips.title: One approval
tips.body: Once network applies, chant plans app again with the real export, then edge once app applies. The approval already given covers both rounds.

applied.reply: Done. Subnet c was created, app's worker imported its id, and edge recorded the worker's id, all in the same apply.
